captions.text: Doodle wants a Stockholm's / worth of power. How many / [jobs] does Sweden get?
captions.plain: Doodle wants a Stockholm's worth of power. How many jobs does Sweden get?

captions.text: The deal allows up to / 2,000 MW: about as much / as [all of Stockholm].
captions.plain: The deal allows up to 2,000 MW: about as much as all of Stockholm.

captions.text: The seller says 500 jobs. / Doodle: maybe hundreds, / it's still [early days].
captions.plain: The seller says 500 jobs. Doodle: maybe hundreds, it's still early days.

captions.text: The grid operator warns: / unless new power is built, / prices rise [nationwide].
captions.plain: The grid operator warns: unless new power is built, prices rise nationwide.

captions.text: Power: one Stockholm. / Jobs: [too early to say].
captions.plain: Power: one Stockholm. Jobs: too early to say.
